# NeuralNg Paginator

> Angular 22+ standalone Signal paginator at `@neural-ng/core/paginator`.

## Rules

- Import `NeuralPaginator` from `@neural-ng/core/paginator`.
- `pageIndex` is zero-based and is a model input.
- `pageSize` is a model input; use two-way binding when the selector is shown.
- Page-size selection composes `NeuralSelect`; do not replace it with a native
  `<select>` in generated examples or wrappers.
- `totalItems` is the full collection size, not the visible item count.
- `startIndex` is inclusive; `endIndex` is exclusive and safe for `slice()`.
- `pageChange` is emitted only for user navigation or page-size changes.
- The report and ARIA labels come from the active `NeuralLocaleService`.
- Local `reportTemplate` and partial `labels` override the global locale.
- Report placeholders are `{start}`, `{end}`, `{total}`, `{page}`, and
  `{pageCount}`.
- Keep the information report enabled unless equivalent context is provided.
- Use `paginatorClass` for the internal nav and `classes` for typed part slots.
- `unstyled` removes visual classes, not structure, behavior, or ARIA semantics.
- Do not add a dependency from core to `@neural-ng/icons`.
- Navigation icons use overridable Neural Icons class inputs.
- Use `rounded` for circular controls and `outlined` for the borderless visual
  variant; they can be combined and do not alter paginator behavior.

## Canonical example

```html
<neural-paginator
  [totalItems]="items().length"
  [(pageIndex)]="pageIndex"
  [(pageSize)]="pageSize"
  [pageSizeOptions]="[10, 20, 50]"
  (pageChange)="handlePageChange($event)"
/>
```

Current-page buttons use `aria-current="page"`. Navigation uses native buttons;
do not introduce tablist roles or custom arrow-key behavior.
